displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 24 is 2 short and 4 long
meaning: Secondary voltage fuse is open. The chart says to check for a short circuit in the secondary (24 V) wiring.
causes: Short circuit in the 24 V secondary wiring
diySteps: Count 2 short flashes and 4 long flashes. A new fuse on a shorted wire opens again
Technician: find the short in the 24 V wiring, then replace the fuse with the rating printed on the control
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the fuse is open. Do not install a higher-amp fuse.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
